titleEn: The Glory of Kings — God Comes to Zion: A Chain of Prophecies (ch. 106, part 2 of 3)
part: ch. 106, part 2 of 3 — God comes to Zion: a chain of prophecies
about: The catena of prophecy continues: Solomon, Hosea, Micah, Jeremiah, Zechariah, David, Job, Isaiah, Gideon and Moses are each cited, in the frame 'as so-and-so prophesied and said', as foretelling that God will come to Zion and dwell among men. The part ends with the author's explanation of the foreign words 'Mekah' and 'Adonai'.

sentences.t: ወበከመ ፡ ተነበየ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወልዲ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ይትወለድ ፡ መድኅን ፡ እምጽዮን ፡ ወያአትት ፡ ኀጢአተ ፡ እምያዕቆብ ፡ ወበከመ ፡ ተነበየ ፡ ሆሴዕ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ እመጽእ ፡ ኀቤኪ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ወኣንሶሱ ፡ ማእከሌኪ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ይቤ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ቅዱሰ ፡ እስራኤል ፨
sentences.l: And-as prophesied Solomon his-son and-said, 'Let-be-born saviour from-Zion, and-he-removes sin from-Jacob.' And-as prophesied Hosea prophet and-said, 'I-come to-you, Zion, and-I-walk-about in-the-midst-of-you, Jerusalem,' said God, holy-one-of Israel.
sentences.i: And as Solomon his son prophesied and said: 'A saviour shall be born from Zion, and he will take away sin from Jacob.' And as the prophet Hosea prophesied and said: 'I will come to you, Zion, and I will walk about in your midst, Jerusalem,' said God, the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.n: The whole catena is built on one frame: ወበከመ ተነበየ X ወይቤ 'and-as prophesied X and-said' (ወ- 'and', በ- + ከመ 'as', perfect ተነበየ 'he prophesied' with the subject after the verb, then ወይቤ 'and he said'). It occurs eighteen times in this part; I explain it here and only nudge afterwards. ወልዲ is Bezold's spelling of 'his son' (-ዲ for -ሁ). ይትወለድ is the tä-stem 'let him be born / he shall be born' (imperfect and subjunctive have the same form); ወያአትት 'and he takes away' (stem uncertain); እም- 'from' (እምጽዮን, እምያዕቆብ). ወኣንሶሱ 'and I will walk about' is the 1cs imperfect (ኣ- is this edition's spelling of the 1cs prefix) of the four-radical verb ንሶሰወ; the exact form is uncertain (?). ማእከሌኪ 'in your midst' (-ኪ 'you', feminine, because Zion is addressed). ቅዱሰ እስራኤል 'Holy One of Israel' is a construct. The attributions to Solomon and Hosea are the text's own; I name no exact passage for either (?). Here ፨ closes the unit.

sentences.l: And-as prophesied Micah prophet and-said, 'Appears word-of God in-Jerusalem, and-law goes-out from-Zion.' And-as prophesied Hosea prophet and-said, 'Appears God upon earth, and-dwells with man like-us.' And-as prophesied Jeremiah prophet and-said, 'Will-be-sent saviour from-Zion, and-he-removes sin from-people-of Israel.' And-as prophesied Micah prophet and-said, 'Comes God from-heaven, and-dwells in his-hall.'
sentences.i: And as the prophet Micah prophesied and said: 'The word of God will appear in Jerusalem, and law will go out from Zion.' And as the prophet Hosea prophesied and said: 'God will appear upon the earth and dwell with men like us.' And as the prophet Jeremiah prophesied and said: 'A saviour will be sent from Zion, and he will take away sin from the people of Israel.' And as the prophet Micah prophesied and said: 'God comes from heaven and dwells in his hall.'
sentences.n: Four more 'and-as prophesied' quotations (the frame of the first unit), kept in one unit because the source has no stop between them (49 words, no ፤ to cut at). The first echoes Micah 4:2 (and Isaiah 2:3) (?). ያስተርኢ is the ʾastä-stem 'he/it appears'; ወየኀድር 'and he dwells'; ከማነ 'like us' (ከማ + -ነ). ይትፌኖ is read as a tä-stem of ፈነወ 'he will be sent' (?); the spelling with ፌ is unusual, so the reading rests on the context (a saviour coming from Zion). ሕዝበ እስራኤል 'people-of Israel' is a construct chain. Where the source reads ወይ ፡ ቤ the wordspace is a slip for ወይቤ 'and he said' (?); kept as printed. ይመጽእ 'he comes'; ጽርሑ 'his hall' (ጽርሕ + -ሁ), i.e. his sanctuary. The attributions to Micah, Hosea and Jeremiah are the text's own; I name no passage for Hosea or Jeremiah (?).

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ተነበየ ፡ ዘካርያስ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ተፈሥሒ ፡ ወለተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ናሁ ፡ ሕያው ፡ አነ ፡ ወአኀድር ፡ ውስቴትኪ ፡ ይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቅዱሰ ፡ እስራኤል ።
sentences.l: As prophesied Zechariah prophet and-said, 'Rejoice, daughter-of Zion; behold, living I, and-I-dwell within-you,' said God, holy-one-of Israel.
sentences.i: As the prophet Zechariah prophesied and said: 'Rejoice, daughter of Zion; behold, I live, and I will dwell within you,' said God, the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.n: The text attributes this to Zechariah; it corresponds to Zechariah 2:10 (2:14 in some numberings), though I am not sure the clause ናሁ ሕያው አነ belongs to that passage (?). Here the frame lacks ወ- (በከመ ተነበየ). ተፈሥሒ is the feminine imperative 'rejoice!'; ወለተ ጽዮን 'daughter-of Zion' (construct); ናሁ 'behold'; ሕያው አነ 'living (am) I'. ውስቴትኪ 'within you' (-ኪ, feminine). The printed spelling እግዚአብሔር with አ differs from እግዚኣብሔር above; both are 'God'.

sentences.t: ወበከመ ፡ ተነበየ ፡ ሚኪያስ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ናሁ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይመጽእ ፡ ወያበርህ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ ፡ ወፀሐየ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ ስሙ ።
sentences.l: And-as prophesied Micah prophet and-said, 'Behold God comes, and-gives-light to-those-who fear-him, and-sun-of righteousness (is) his-name.'
sentences.i: And as the prophet Micah prophesied and said: 'Behold, God comes, and he gives light to those who fear him, and 'sun of righteousness' is his name.'
sentences.n: ወያበርህ is the a-stem 'and he gives light, enlightens'; ለእለ ይፈርህዎ 'to those who fear him' (እለ plural relative; ይፈርህዎ 3mp + -ዎ 'him'). ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun-of righteousness' is a construct; the ascription of this quotation to Micah is the text's own: I know the phrase from Malachi 4:2, not from Micah, and I do not vouch for the attribution (?).

sentences.l: And-as prophesied Hosea prophet and-said, 'Comes God over-you, Jerusalem, and-appears in-within-you.' And-as prophesied David prophet and-said, 'And-they-shall-live, and-they-give-him from-gold-of Arabia, and-continually they-pray on-his-account, and-it-will-be support (?) for-all earth at heads-of mountains.' And-as prophesied Job righteous and-said, 'God walks-about upon earth, and-goes upon sea like dry-land.' And-as prophesied David prophet and-said, 'He-bowed heavens and-descended.'
sentences.i: And as the prophet Hosea prophesied and said: 'God comes upon you, Jerusalem, and appears in your midst.' And as the prophet David prophesied and said: 'They shall live, and they shall give him of the gold of Arabia, and continually they shall pray on his behalf; and there will be a support (?) for all the earth on the tops of the mountains.' And as Job the righteous prophesied and said: 'God walks about upon the earth and goes upon the sea as upon dry land.' And as the prophet David prophesied and said: 'He bowed the heavens and came down.'
sentences.n: Four more quotations in the same frame (52 words, no ፤ to cut at). David's words correspond to Psalm 72 (15–16) (?); ወየሐዩ and ወይሁብዎ 'they shall live' / 'they shall give him' are 3mp; እምወርቀ ዐረብ 'of the gold of Arabia' (construct); ዘልፈ 'continually'; ይጼልዩ 'they pray'. ምስማከ is a crux: 'support, prop' (?) (cf. ሰመከ 'lean'), not a firm reading; the house entry also offers 'nails', which suits 'for all the earth' less. After ወይከውን 'and it will be' it is a predicate accusative. በእንቲአሁ 'on his account'. ኢዮብ ጻድቅ 'Job the righteous' is the text's own attribution (Job is called ጻድቅ, not ነቢይ); the sense recalls Job 9:8 (walking on the sea) (?). ያንሶሱ 'he walks about' (the verb of the first unit, ወኣንሶሱ, there 1cs, here 3ms) and ወየሐውር 'and he goes'; ከመ የብስ 'like dry land'. አጽነነ ሰማያተ ወወረደ 'he bowed the heavens and came down' is Psalm 18:9 (also 144:5).

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ተነበየ ፡ ኢሳይያስ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ድንግል ፡ ትፀንስ ፡ ወትወልድ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ወትሰምዮ ፡ ስሞ ፡ አማኑኤል ፡ ወበከመ ፡ ተነበየ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ወለድኩከ ፡ እምከርሥ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ኮከበ ፡ ጽባሕ ፤
sentences.l: As prophesied Isaiah prophet and-said, 'Behold virgin conceives and-bears son, and-she-calls-him his-name Emmanuel.' And-as prophesied David prophet and-said, 'I-begot-you from-womb from-before star-of morning;'
sentences.i: As the prophet Isaiah prophesied and said: 'Behold, a virgin will conceive and bear a son, and she will call his name Emmanuel.' And as the prophet David prophesied and said: 'I begot you from the womb, before the morning star;'
sentences.n: Isaiah 7:14. ትፀንስ ወትወልድ 'she conceives and bears' (3fs imperfects); ወልደ 'a son' is accusative. ወትሰምዮ is 'and she will call him' (imperfect of ሰምየ + the object suffix -ዮ 'him', with ስሞ 'his name' following as a second accusative; English idiom drops the 'him'). The form is also 2ms 'you will call'; 3fs is chosen because the virgin is the subject of the two verbs before it (?); ስሞ 'his name'. The second quotation is Psalm 110:3: ወለድኩከ 'I begot you' (1cs perfect + -ከ); ኮከበ ጽባሕ 'star-of morning'. The unit ends at ፤.

sentences.l: And-again said God, said-to-me, 'My-son you, and-I today I-begot-you.' And-as prophesied Gideon and-said, 'Behold he-descends like dew upon fleece.' And-as prophesied David prophet and-said, 'God looked-out (?) from-heaven upon offspring-of mankind, and-from-the-prepared-(place), hall-of his-sanctuary.' As prophesied Moses prophet and-said, 'And-they-say all sons-of God: Strong is-he, for he-avenges blood-of his-children.' And-as prophesied David and-said, 'And-there I-make-sprout horn for-David, and-I-prepare lamp for-my-anointed, and-I-clothe-them shame, for-his-enemies, and-upon-him will-bear-fruit my-holiness.' And-as said Hosea prophet, 'Do-not-fear, for you-will-not-be-ashamed and you-will-not-be-startled, on-account-of that-you-praised (?);'
sentences.i: And again he said: God said to me, 'You are my son, and I have begotten you today.' And as Gideon prophesied and said: 'Behold, he will come down like dew upon a fleece.' And as the prophet David prophesied and said: 'God looked down (?) from heaven upon the offspring of mankind, and from the prepared (place), the hall of his sanctuary.' As the prophet Moses prophesied and said: 'And all the sons of God will say: He is strong, for he avenges the blood of his children.' And as David prophesied and said: 'And there I will make a horn sprout for David, and I will prepare a lamp for my anointed; I will clothe his enemies with shame, and upon him my holiness will bear fruit.' And as the prophet Hosea said: 'Do not fear, for you will not be put to shame and you will not be dismayed, because you praised (?);'
sentences.n: The longest unit (75 words) has no ፤ inside, so it is kept whole; it is a run of six quotations. The first, ወካዕበ ይቤ እግዚኣብሔር ይቤለኒ, can be read 'and again he said: God said to me' (ይቤ with an unnamed subject, God the subject of ይቤለኒ) or 'and again God said, he said to me'; either way 'me' is the quoting prophet, so I take the speaker to be David continuing from the last unit (?). It corresponds to Psalm 2:7 (ይቤለኒ 'he said to me', ወልድየ 'my son'). The Gideon quotation is the text's own attribution; the sense recalls the fleece of Judges 6 and the dew of Psalm 72:6 (?). David: ሐወጸ is a 3ms perfect, 'looked down' (?), the root and sense not secure (a house entry elsewhere reads 'looked out (?)'); ላዕለ እጓለ እመሕያው 'upon the offspring of mankind' (compare Psalm 14:2 / 33:13–14) (?); ድልው 'ready, prepared' (ወእምድልው, 'and from the prepared', the noun 'place' supplied (?)); ጽርሐ መቅደሱ 'hall-of his-sanctuary'. Moses (the text's attribution; compare Deuteronomy 32:43) (?): ወይብሉ 'and they will say'; ይትቤቀል 'he avenges' (tä-stem; the object is ደመ 'blood-of'). Next David, compare Psalm 132:17–18 (?): ኣበቊል 'I make sprout', ወኣስተዴሉ 'and I prepare', ወኣለብሶሙ 'and I clothe them' (1cs imperfects with the ኣ- prefix of this edition); ለጸላእቱ 'for his enemies' names the owners of -ሙ 'them' (ለ- after an anticipating suffix), hence 'I will clothe his enemies'; ለመሲሕየ 'for my anointed' (መሲሕ + -የ); ይፈሪ 'bears fruit'; ቅድሳትየ 'my holiness'. Last, Hosea, in the frame ወበከመ ይቤ 'and as said' (not 'prophesied' here): ኢትፍራህ 'do not fear' (2ms), ኢትትኀፈር 'you will not be ashamed' and ወኢትደንግፅ 'and you will not be dismayed' (ደንገፀ 'be startled, dismayed' (?)); both are ኢ- + 2ms imperfect and are read as parallel under እስመ 'for'. The wording resembles Isaiah 54:4; the ascription to Hosea is the text's own (?). በእንተ ዘሰባሕከ: በእንተ ዘ- + verb means 'because' in the house entry, so 'because you praised' (ሰብሐ 'praise', 2ms perfect); but the printed ባ (4th order) is not what I expect for ሰብሕከ, so the form may be corrupt and the sense is uncertain (?).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ስምዑኒ ፡ ስምዑኒ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ፍትሕየ ፡ ርቱዕ ፡ እመጽእ ፡ ወአኀድር ፡ ምስሌክሙ ፡ ወይትዌከሉ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ በብርሃንየ ፤
sentences.l: And-again he-said, 'Hear-me, hear-me, my-people, for my-judgement right; I-come and-I-dwell with-you, and-will-trust nations in-my-light;'
sentences.i: And again he said: 'Hear me, hear me, my people, for my judgement is right; I will come and dwell with you, and the nations will put their trust in my light;'
sentences.n: ስምዑኒ is the imperative 'hear me!' (plural, -ኒ 'me'), doubled for emphasis. ፍትሕየ 'my judgement' (-የ 'my'); ርቱዕ 'right', a predicate adjective. እመጽእ ወአኀድር 'I come and I dwell'; ምስሌክሙ 'with you' (plural). ወይትዌከሉ 'and they will trust' (tä-stem, with በ- 'in': በብርሃንየ 'in my light', ብርሃን + -የ). Close in wording to Isaiah 51:4–5 (?); the author does not name the speaker, only ወካዕበ ይቤ 'and again he said', which continues the last unit's speaker (Hosea) if the subject is unchanged (?).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ኮኑ ፡ ፍቁራኒሁ ፡ ለክርስቶስ ፡ ወበከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዘኢያአምር ፡ ተቀንየ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምስማዐ ፡ እዝን ፡ ተሰጥዉኒ ፤
sentences.l: For nations became beloved-ones-his, of-Christ. And-as said David prophet, 'People who-know-not served to-me; at-hearing-of ear they-submitted (?) to-me;'
sentences.i: For the nations became beloved ones of Christ. And as the prophet David said: 'A people who do not know served me; at the hearing of the ear they submitted (?) to me;'
sentences.n: The first clause is the author's own comment. ፍቁራኒሁ ለክርስቶስ 'his-beloved-ones, of-Christ' is the anticipating-suffix genitive (ለ- naming the possessor after -ሁ). Then Psalm 18:43–44. በከመ ይቤ 'as he said' replaces the 'prophesied' verb. ዘኢያአምር 'who does not know' (ዘ- + ኢ- + imperfect; the object is left unstated); ተቀንየ ሊተ 'served me' (ሊተ 'to me'); ምስማዐ እዝን 'hearing-of ear' (construct); ተሰጥዉኒ is read as ተሰጥዉ (3mp perfect, tä-stem) + -ኒ 'me', a plural verb after the singular ተቀንየ (ሕዝብ is collective); 'they submitted' is a guess from the context and the root is not established ('they were given over to me' is also possible) (?).

sentences.t: ወለአይሁድ ፡ ሰ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ ነኪር ፡ ሐሰዉኒ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ ነኪር ፡ በልዩ ፡ ወሐንከሱ ፡ በፍኖቶሙ ፡ ሕያው ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወቡሩክ ፡ አምላኪየ ፤
sentences.l: And-to-Jews (ሰ 'as for') he-said-to-them, 'Sons-of strangers lied-to-me; sons-of strangers grew-old (?) and-limped in-their-ways. Living God, and-blessed my-God;'
sentences.i: And to the Jews, however, he said: 'Foreign sons lied to me; foreign sons grew old (?) and limped in their ways. God is living, and my God is blessed;'
sentences.n: The source prints ወለአይሁድ ፡ ሰ with a stray wordspace; ሰ is the contrastive -ሰ 'as for' detached from ወለአይሁድ (so ወለአይሁድሰ) (?); kept as printed. ይቤሎሙ 'he said to them'. The quotation is Psalm 18:44–46. ውሉደ ነኪር 'sons-of strangers' (construct; ነኪር 'strange, foreign'). ሐሰዉኒ 'they lied to me' (ሐሰወ + -ኒ); በልዩ 'they grew old' (a 3mp perfect of በልየ 'be old, wear out'; root and sense unconfirmed) (?); ሐንከሱ 'they limped'; በፍኖቶሙ 'in their ways'. ሕያው እግዚኣብሔር 'living (is) God'; ወቡሩክ አምላኪየ 'and blessed (is) my God' (አምላክ + -የ 'my', with the linking vowel, አምላኪ-የ).

sentences.t: ሕያው ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይብለከ ፡ በእንተ ፡ መለኮቱ ፡ ይነግር ፡ ወቡሩክ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይብለከ ፡ በእንተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ለብሰ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ይነግር ፡ ወካዕበ ፡ ይቤ ፡ በእንተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ለብሰ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ በኢሳይያስ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ መኑ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ መካሕ ፡ ዘይወፅእ ፡ እምኤዶም ፡ አዶናይ ፡ ዘወረደ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ወይለብስ ፡ ዘበሶር ፡ ግሩም ፤
sentences.l: Living God: when he-says-to-you concerning his-divinity, he-tells; and-blessed my-God: when he-says-to-you concerning that-which put-on flesh, he-tells. And-again he-said concerning that-which put-on flesh, by Isaiah prophet: 'Who (is) this Mekah who-comes-out from-Edom, Adonai, who-descended from-heaven, and-puts-on that-of-Bosor, awesome;'
sentences.i: 'God is living': when he says this to you, he tells of his divinity; and 'blessed is my God': when he says this to you, he tells of the one (?) who put on flesh. And again he said, concerning the one (?) who put on flesh, through the prophet Isaiah: 'Who is this Mekah who comes out of Edom, Adonai, who came down from heaven and puts on that of Bosor, awesome (?);'
sentences.n: The author now comments on the verse just quoted. ሶበ ይብለከ 'when he says to you' (ብህለ + -ከ); I take the subject to be David, the speaker of the quotation, though 'it' (the verse) is possible (?). ይነግር 'he tells'. እንተ ለብሰ ሥጋ 'who put on flesh': እንተ is the feminine relative, where ዘ- would be expected for a masculine person; this may mean 'that nature which...' or be a slip (?). በኢሳይያስ ነቢይ 'by Isaiah the prophet' (the passage corresponds to Isaiah 63:1; the ascription is the text's own). መካሕ and አዶናይ (the Hebrew divine title Adonai) are foreign words, explained in the next unit; እምኤዶም 'from Edom'. ዘበሶር: ዘ- 'that of' + በሶር, 'that of Bosor' (the town of Isaiah 63:1) (?); the next unit seems to take it as 'flesh' (compare Hebrew basar). ግሩም 'awesome, fearful' may describe the wearer or what is worn; the Geʿez does not say.

sentences.t: መካሕ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይብል ፡ ዘመዐዛሁ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ወአዶናይ ፡ ብሂል ፡ ቃለ ፡ አብ ፡ ዘእምቅድመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ወልደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይለብስ ፡ ዘበሶር ፡ ግሩም ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይብል ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ለአዳም ፡ ገሃደ ፡ ያርኢ ።
sentences.l: Mekah, when he-says, whose-fragrance-his good; and-Adonai meaning word-of Father who-from-before the-age, son-of God. 'He-puts-on that-of-Bosor, awesome,' when he-says, his-body, of-Adam, plainly he-shows.
sentences.i: 'Mekah,' when he says it, means 'one whose fragrance is good'; and 'Adonai' means the Word of the Father who is from before the world, the Son of God. And when he says 'he puts on that of Bosor, awesome', he plainly shows his body, which is Adam's.
sentences.n: The explanation the part ends on. ዘመዐዛሁ ሠናይ 'whose-fragrance-his (is) good' (ዘ- + noun + -ሁ); ብሂል 'meaning, that is' (the verbal noun, as in part 1); ቃለ አብ 'word-of Father' and ወልደ እግዚኣብሔር 'son-of God' are constructs in apposition; ዘእምቅድመ ዓለም 'who (is) from before the age'. ይለብስ ዘበሶር ግሩም ('he puts on that of Bosor, awesome') is repeated from the last unit and glossed: ሥጋሁ ለአዳም 'his-body, of-Adam' (ለ- naming the owner after the suffix), 'which he shows openly' (ገሃደ ያርኢ, 'plainly he shows'). The reading of ዘበሶር as 'flesh' is the author's, and I cannot confirm it from the Geʿez alone (?).
